response: Yes, sternal plating can improve sternal stability for both primary and secondary sternal closure. Sternal plating involves the use of metal plates to reinforce and stabilize the sternum, which can help to promote proper healing, reduce the risk of complications, and improve patient outcomes. By providing additional support and stability to the sternum, sternal plating can help to enhance the healing process and reduce the risk of sternal dehiscence or other complications.
